title: Odyssey Freedom
description: A back-to-basics flat-world freebuild creative server.
body:
# Odyssey Freedom

Odyssey Freedom is a return to the basics of Creative/FreeBuild servers, with a massive flat world for everyone to build in, but with the bonus of every user having access to things like WorldEdit, ImageFrame, ItemEditor and more.

We're currently on 1.21.11, but support all 1.21.x Minecraft versions!

Our full offering includes:
- Five worlds to build in (Flat, Normal, Nether, End, Paige)
- Access to FastAsyncWorldEdit for all players
- BuildersUtilities, EasyArmorStands, HeadDB and SignManager for easier building
- Fun plugins like CrackShot, ImageFrame, ItemEditor and GSit
- Grief Prevention with CoreProtect: every edit made to the world is logged, and griefs can be undone in seconds, no matter how damaging they are.

Come join us today!
